title: Slowly and Leisurely, their Free Time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One weekend, I'm walking around town
after finishing up some
errands, when I run
into Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm not up to anything in particular, just
taking a stroll. I mean, how
could I resist
with such nice weather?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It is indeed prime strolling weather.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh! ...You wouldn't mind?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Well then, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right. While I have you,
there's
someplace I'd like to take
you, so why
don't you follow me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know where I was expecting her to
lead me, but it sure wasn't a
pool hall.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's my first time,
actually. Rickey
was saying she wanted to
take us here
sometime, you see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But then I got to thinking maybe a trendy
game like this would pique
your interest
too.

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all! Can you pocket the
balls in this special configuration?! You
get two chances! Winners will be
presented with a
luxurious prize!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A luxurious present? Look at that, it's a
one-day free pass! Rickey
would be over
the moon... You think I could win it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Roll... Clink!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, would you look at that! You were so
close. I whiffed completely,
but you're a
natural at this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first try ends in failure.
I get one more
attempt. My shoulders
stiffen up from the
pressure.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Trainer, deep breaths now, deep
breaths. In moments like this,
it's best to
pause and collect yourself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Like this. In... and out...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her sweet smile and laid-back demeanor
combine to take all the
tension right out
of my shoulders. Now I'm ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clack! Thud!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohhh my!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And in they go, every last one! You're so
good at this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense, I didn't do anything but watch.
The credit belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, this cafe I heard about from Falco. I
figured you might like
these places that
everyone posts about on the Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Here you are! One Pancake Mountain, with
a big ol' dollop of
whipped cream and
extra fruit and butter!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me... I'm at a loss for words.
Something this impressive is
bound to give
you all sorts of good luck.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Praise be, praise be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It does seem plausible that a stack of
pancakes this massive would
have some
kind of divine power.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now then, shall we dig in?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nom, nom...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ooh! It's so fluffy—this is to die for!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't remember the last time I had this
much fun eating out. It makes
the food all
the more delicious.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It was Tarumae who told me about this
store. Trainer, you were
talking about
wanting a new jacket, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here, how about this one? The fabric
looks of good quality, and the
make is
sturdy too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, it looks wonderful on you!
Now how about you turn
around for me
real quick?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear,
there's a big old hole in the back.
A bug must have gotten
to it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fashion? So you're telling me it's supposed to be like that? Sigh. It's so hard to keep up with all these trends. But I learned something new.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you mean it? Well, if you're offering,
then I suppose I'll have you
give my
wardrobe a trendy makeover. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well... I owe you a big thank you. Didn't
mean to keep you all day
long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From billiards to the cafe and then the
clothing store, she took care
to pick
places she thought I would enjoy, and I
appreciate that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I didn't do anything.
Everything was so
new and unfamiliar to me,
I'm afraid I only
wasted more of your time. But, yes...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It really was a fun day. I learned so many
new things from you, it was
hard for me
not to get all giddy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter the place, when I'm with
Wonder Acute, time seems to pass
more
slowly, and I always find a smile on my
face.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: You don't say?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...I'd like that.
We'll have to find the time
to do this again.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... We should "hang" again? Can you
believe it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, my! Seeing such a look of delight on
your face just warms my heart. Try the tea
too. I put it in a thermos,
so it's nice and
steamy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer had that same smile again...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's good... Glad to know I wasn't the
only one having fun.
